definitions.text: System that consists of at least two electron conductors (electrodes) in contact with ionic conductors (electrolytes).

notes.1: The two electrodes may be a working electrode and an auxiliary electrode.
notes.2: An electrochemical cell with current flow can operate either as a galvanic cell or as an electrolytic cell.
notes.4: If processes of interest occur at both the anode and the cathode of a cell, the cell should comprise two electrodes.
